An '''oxygen recirculator''',<ref name="SWS" /> also known as an '''air recirculator'''<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref> or '''air recycler'''<ref name="FBS">''[[Flashpoint! Brak Sector]]''</ref> was part of [[Life support/Legends|life support]] systems. They were used in [[Ejector seat/Legends|ejector seats]], along with a [[heating element]]. They were able to provide an extravehicular [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] with around twenty-four [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] of [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]].<ref name="SWS" /> They were also used aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]] as part of the life support system.<ref name="CP" />
